copper-motion.prompt: A six-second precise editorial macro film of the EXACT industrial copper busbar connection in the reference image. Preserve the real-looking copper plates, bolted joint geometry, metal finish, installation and framing. The camera makes a very slow physically plausible 5cm lateral dolly across the contact joint, revealing grazing warm light on machined copper grain and the bolt head. Focus begins on copper surface grain then settles on the boundary where two conductors meet. This is a conceptual material study for an independent energy intelligence house: the physical interface before it becomes a measurement. No invented laboratory equipment, no added devices, no electric sparks, no pulses, no LEDs, no flowing energy animation, no colored clouds, no text, no numbers, no map, no hands. Deep graphite enclosure, subtle warm metal glints, understated cinematic depth, stable industrial editorial photography, no zoom jump or cut. Preserve exact subject, natural realistic material, absolutely no liquid copper or morphing geometry. Silent.
copper-motion.rights: AI-generated conceptual material study from the project's existing generated copper image. Does not claim a real installation, field capture, measured performance, instrument calibration or a manufactured NIVAR product. No stock footage, sound, font or third-party model incorporated.
